description:
The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Baltimore District, is conducting market research for a potential future requirement for technical support services. This Sources Sought notice seeks to identify qualified firms capable of providing:

  • Area A: Construction Management Support (CMS)

  • Area B: Scheduling, Project Controls, and Delay/Claims Analysis

The Government will use responses to this notice to inform its acquisition strategy. This is not a solicitation. Responses are required via a survey link contained within the full announcement details and/or attachments. Interested parties must review all documents for the complete requirement description and submission instructions.
